title: Tool orchestration: multi-tool parallel execution, result injection, and retry policies
author: Maya Alvarez
release_notes: Adds configurable multi-tool orchestration primitives: parallel execution flag, per-tool retry policies, and result injection strategies. Improves streaming stability for tool outputs and documents new OpenAI-compat API options.
description: This PR adds an ergonomics layer for tool/function calling to support common production patterns: invoking multiple tools in a single call (sequential or parallel), injecting tool outputs into the model context in configurable ways, and specifying per-tool retry/timeout policies. Motivation: customers have been orchestrating chains in ad-hoc ways at the client layer which causes latency spikes, duplicated requests, and inconsistent streaming behaviour. This change centralizes orchestration in the server runtime, preserving streaming semantics while enabling safe parallelism and deterministic injection strategies. Summary of changes: 1) runtime: new ToolOrchestrator component that schedules and executes tools with concurrency limits, retry/backoff, and result-normalization; 2) API: OpenAI-compat additions to the call payload (tools[].parallel, tools[].retry_policy, tools[].injection) and a top-level tools_execution policy; 3) streaming: stable message envelope for tool events so client SDKs can surface partial tool outputs; 4) SDKs/docs: examples and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves current single-tool sequential semantics when no parallel flags or orchestration options are provided. Tests: unit and integration tests added to validate concurrency, retry, and stream envelope ordering. See related Linear tasks ENG-1412, ENG-1429 and support ticket SUP-987 for customer repros.

review_comments: Connor Liu: Nice overall shape. Two concerns: 1) we need deterministic stream ordering guarantees when tools run in parallel (clients rely on seq numbers), 2) double-injection edge case if a tool result is both streamed and then injected synchronously. Can you add a design note?

Maya Alvarez (author): Added explicit seq numbers to the streaming envelope and a 'finalized' flag. The orchestrator now enqueues 'injection' actions after finalization to avoid double-injection. See streaming_envelope.md and orchestrator comments.
Priya Nambiar: Retry semantics look good but need a max-total-time enforcement (cumulative across retries) or else model will wait forever. Also call out SLO impacts in the docs.
Maya Alvarez: Implemented retry_policy.max_total_ms and documented default = 3000ms. Orchestrator aborts remaining retries when total exceeds the limit and emits a tool.error event.

Ibrahim Saleh: Tests flaked when running integration with the shared test harness (race on orchestrator.cleanup). Suggest using per-test ephemeral tmpdir and deterministic clock for backoff. Also add an explicit shutdown hook to join pending threads.
Maya Alvarez: Fixed (deterministic clock injected into backoff util; orchestrator.shutdown joins executors). Re-ran flaky test locally and on CI.
